items.title: Watch: Life and career of iconic actor Sir Patrick Stewart
items.summary: Over seven decades, Sir Patrick received multiple Emmys and Golden Globes, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and a knighthood from Queen Elizabeth II.

items.title: 'Continue your journey': Key moments of leaked Spain train crash audio
items.summary: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.

items.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
items.summary: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

items.title: Crypto worth billions frozen after suspected Binance hack
items.summary: The firm said transactions are suspended while it conducts security checks and will "cover all losses".

items.title: Bombshell confession in The Traitors as faithfuls finally turn the screw
items.summary: Could the faithfuls finally come good in Thursday's penultimate episode?

items.title: What are the government's options for reducing welfare spending?
items.summary: BBC Verify examines how much the welfare system costs and the options the government could use to reduce it.

items.title: Hyrox athlete who soiled herself in race tells BBC she put others at risk but says backlash was traumatic
items.summary: In her first interview since the incident, Joanna Wietrzyk told the BBC she takes responsibility for it but did not deserve such a severe backlash.

items.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.summary: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.
